grid_rx: grid R/X behind the point of connection (Thevenin, SCR on the 400 V / 125 kW base)
scr: SCRs studied (None = stiff, L_g 0); pcs_spec admits '5 .. stiff'
cf_tol: C_f tolerance (MKP film, a request-for-quotation part)
sensor: phase-current sensor being frozen in sim/pcs_design.py by a parallel task (orchestrator brief 2026-10-05; read from pcs_spec phase_current_sensor at run time when that block exists, else this entry); PCS-CTL rev A0 re-valued its ladders for the 3.2 mV/A part (PCM-20). Loop: the design check's chain delay with its sensor term replaced by t_step, as one lag (conservative: 200 kHz alone is a 0.8 us lag)
slow_sensor: robustness corner: current-chain delay x this (a sensor or AFE slower than its data-sheet maximum)
fc_grid_Hz: candidate stiff-grid crossovers of the current loop, K_p = 2 pi f_c (L1 + L2)
fz_Hz: fundamental resonant gain K_r = 2 K_p 2 pi f_z (dq-equivalent PI zero, error time constant ~6 ms)
harmonics: resonant terms named by the pcs_spec hand-over; each kept only if its lead fits
sigma_h_Hz: harmonic resonant gains K_rh = 2 K_p 2 pi sigma (harmonic error time constant ~16 ms)
lead_margin_deg: harmonic term kept only if |phi_h + angle(plant seen by it)| <= 90 - this at every SCR
res_decay_frac: ... and only if its closed-loop mode decays at >= this x 2 pi sigma_h at every SCR and corner (a slower mode is close to the stability limit: the GFL reference path tipped h13 over at SCR 5 on import)
sogi_k: SOGI band-pass of the C_f-voltage feed-forward (fundamental only, damping 0.71)
ff_reseed_pu: firmware: when the sensed C_f voltage leaves the SOGI output by more than this (pu of the phase peak), the SOGI state is re-seeded on the sensed vector (large steps only; no effect on the small-signal loop)
pll_dw_max_Hz: PLL frequency (integrator) clamp +/- (45-55 Hz), conditional integration
pll_slew_Hz: PLL total angle slew clamp +/- (lets the proportional path follow a phase jump)
vd_lpf_Hz: low-pass of the PLL-frame voltage that turns P/Q into current references (at 100 Hz the P/V conversion couples the DC-link loop into the h5/h7 resonant modes at SCR 5 and destabilises them on import)
f_dc_Hz: DC-link voltage-loop crossover on C_dc (PI zero at a quarter of it)
p_cpl_W: DC/DC as a constant-power source or load on the DC bus, up to the PCS rating
m_max: modulation limit |u| <= m_max V_dc / sqrt(3) (min-max zero sequence; pcs_spec's 0.98 rule)
f_cv_max_Hz: grid-forming C_f-voltage loop: highest crossover parameter tried, 100 Hz steps (inner loop P only)
fzv_ratios: grid-forming voltage PR: dq-equivalent zero = crossover / ratio, scanned with the crossover; choice = the pair meeting the rule with the largest headroom min(PM - 40 deg, 5 x (GM - 6 dB))
gfm_zeta_min: grid forming, grid-connected: least-damped closed-loop mode below 1 kHz has at least this damping ratio at every SCR (the multi-loop counterpart of the margin rule; the gains before the two-axis scan left 0.02 at about 100 Hz)
droop_q: Q-V droop: 5 % of V per 125 kvar
f_pq_Hz: power measurement low-pass of the droop
zv_pu: virtual impedance R_v, X_v (pu of 1.28 ohm), quasi-static at 50 Hz (0.05 / 0.15 pu left the grid-connected droop mode at 2-3 Hz unstable on every SCR; this pair is the smallest of a scan that is stable from stiff to SCR 5)
bg_harm_pct: background grid-voltage harmonics for the THDi estimate (typical LV values; EN 50160 allows 6 / 5 / 3.5 / 3 %)
dt_resid_ns: dead-time compensation residual once each leg's dead time is identified at commissioning
r_sc_ohm: terminal short: resistance (bolted fault behind a short cable)
t_lim_s: firmware: current limit 1.2 x I_max held for <= this, then trip (pcs_spec hand-over)
isr_cyc_per_op: C28x + FPU32 + TMU, compiled C: cycles per floating-point operation incl. loads/stores
isr_overhead_cyc: ISR entry/exit and context save with the FPU registers, cycles
codes: grid-code-like limits FROM MEMORY (EN 50549-1 / ENTSO-E RfG / IEC 62116 class; Megarevo's 20 ms transfer), not verified - the standards are not on file

current_loop.structure: alpha-beta PR on the converter (L1) current; SOGI-filtered C_f-voltage feed-forward re-seeded on large steps; reference = P/Q in the PLL frame + j w C_eq v_d
